bull.point: Order inflows hit Rs. 1,080 billion, beating 10-12% guidance with 14% growth.
NWC to sales ratio improved to 4.9%, beating 10% target.
PAT grew 27.2% YoY, outpacing 15.8% revenue growth.
FY27 revenue growth at 11.4% is on track for 10-12% target.

bear.point: FY26 revenue growth of 11.8% missed the 15% guidance.
EBITDA margin fell 0.4 pp YoY to 14.1%.
Analysts fear prospect list shifts to next calendar year.
